'''Section 7-B''' was located inside the [[Quarek'k]], a large bar complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Section 7-B was in between the barrooms [[Green Dystopia]] and [[Crimson Redrum]].<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] visited the Quarek'k during her hunt for the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]]. Sing was told to seek out [[Calathi]]&mdash;who was working in the Green Dystopia&mdash;by the [[Crimson Redrum]]'s [[Unidentified bartender (Crimson Redrum)|bartender]] when Sing asked for information regarding Pavan. While on her way to the Green Dystopia, she was harassed by three drunk patrons. A short fight ensued where two of the patrons&mdash;a [[Unidentified Shistavanen|Shistavanen]] and an [[Unidentified Utai patron|Utai]]&mdash;were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Sing with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], while the drunk [[Unidentified Zabrak patron|Zabrak]] had his hand cauterized.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows" />
